about.title: Technology with Purpose
about.subtitle: I build digital solutions that grow your business, streamline your operations, and turn visitors into customers.
about.techSubtitle: The technologies and tools behind every project I deliver. I integrate AI into my development process to move faster without cutting corners, keeping the focus on what actually matters: your business problem.

solutions.title: Tailored Solutions
solutions.description: I take your vision and turn it into a digital presence built around your actual goals, ready to grow alongside your business.

partnership.title: End-to-End Partnership
partnership.description: From kickoff to launch, I stay involved, communicate directly, and deliver on time so you always know where your project stands.

results.title: Results-Driven
results.description: The goal is not just a website. It is a business asset that attracts customers, builds trust in your brand, and creates measurable impact.

quality.title: Lasting Quality
quality.description: Every project is built to last. Solid, stable, and ready to evolve as your business grows and its needs change.

devices.title: Available on Every Device
devices.description: Your business looks and works great on any screen. Whether it is a phone, tablet, or desktop, the experience stays sharp and consistent.

speed.title: Speed that Converts
speed.description: A slow site loses customers before they see what you offer. Every project I build is fast by default, optimized for search engines, and designed to make a strong first impression.

ecommerce.title: Modern B2B E-commerce
ecommerce.description: An online store for soccer jerseys in Guatemala, with orders handled directly via the owner's WhatsApp. Clean, responsive design built to turn visits into real sales.

saas1.title: Order SaaS & Digital Menu — Urban Design
saas1.description: A SaaS platform for restaurants with a public website and internal order management. Owners can customize their landing page, publish an interactive menu, and export a PDF version. Built for speed and conversions.

saas2.title: Order SaaS & Digital Menu — Elegant Design
saas2.description: Same platform, different aesthetic. This version targets upscale venues with a refined interface, smooth animations, and load times that compete with native apps.

turboauto.title: Turbo Auto - Mechanic Shop & Carwash
turboauto.description: Digital presence for a mechanic shop and carwash in Quesada, Jutiapa. Showcases their services, includes an exclusive deals section, and pulls in local customers with a clean, professional look.
